title: leftpad package removed from PyPI
summary: The 'leftpad' package was removed from PyPI by the package maintainer. All versions are no longer available for installation. Dependent projects must migrate to alternatives or vendor the code.

evidences.excerpt: Package 'leftpad' not found on PyPI. The package has been removed by the maintainer. This project is no longer available for installation via pip.
Repository shows maintainer announced package removal from PyPI on 2026-01-10. No further releases planned. Users advised to vendor the code or migrate to alternative string padding utilities.

claims.subject: leftpad
claims.statement: The leftpad package has been removed from PyPI by the maintainer. All versions are unavailable for installation.
